description:
Configure a new Service Hook in the TailwindTraders project to trigger a compliance scan. 

Goal: Create a Web Hook subscription that notifies an external service whenever a Pull Request is created in the 'TailwindTraders' repository.

Configuration Details:
- Trigger Event: Pull request created
- Repository: TailwindTraders (Must target this specific repo, not 'All')
- Target Branch: [Any]
- Service: Web Hooks
- Action URL: http://localhost:9090/api/compliance-scan
- Authentication: Basic Authentication
- Username: compliance_bot
- Password: ScanMyCode2024!

Note: The target service (localhost:9090) is offline, so the 'Test' button may fail. This is expected; save the subscription anyway.
